clusters.description: Music releases, performers and bands; all five samples concern recording careers, albums, songs or the music industry.
Conversational first-person posts and advice requests across games, transport, anxiety and finance; generic personal-discussion language dominates rather than one content subject.
Savory cooking ingredients and preparation procedures; the five samples consistently concern recipes and kitchen techniques.
Samples span a settlement, voting discrimination, a historical hurricane, renewable-energy choices and early print news. Place/history vocabulary provides broad overlap without one dominant subject.
Machine-learning methods with a strong image/semantic-segmentation focus; healthcare prediction is a related technical outlier.
Film and television productions, performers, directors and screen-industry careers; the five samples share that subject area.
Mathematical and physical-science modeling, including network dynamics, fluid mechanics, quantum gases, optimization and relativity; quantitative theory is the shared subject area.
Economics/business terms mix with diplomacy, political-value theory and personal allegations; the five samples do not establish one dominant content subject.
Baking, desserts and kitchen preparations; bread, cakes, crepes and a drink recipe share ingredients and food-preparation content.
Film reviews and evaluation of stories, acting and direction; every sampled document discusses a movie.
Biographical/career vocabulary spans military, psychiatry, folklore, pop music and choreography; cohesion largely follows a biography template across heterogeneous subjects.
Sports players, teams, competition and performance; the five samples cover cricket, tennis, basketball, golf and football.
